newsitem.title: USA: Buckle Dec same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Buckle Dec same store sales up.

text.p: The Buckle Inc said Thursday that its same store sales for the five-week period ended January 4 rose 5.6 percent.
Total sales for that period gained 15.5 percent to $33.1 million from $28.7 million for the corresponding year-ago period.
Net sales for the 48 weeks ended January 4, 1997, increased 21.1 percent to $195.6 million from $161.5 million for the year-ago period.
Comparable store sales for the year-to-date period were up 11.2 percent from a year ago.
The Buckle sells casual appear for young men and women, with 181 retail stores in 22 states.
